mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_tenant_usage_daily ( tenant_key, usage_date, request_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_calls, estimated_cost, trace_id, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantKey}, #{usageDate}, #{requestCount}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{toolCalls}, #{estimatedCost}, #{traceToken}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_key, usage_date, request_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_calls, estimated_cost, trace_id, updated_at FROM tb_tenant_usage_daily WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND usage_date = #{usageDate}

SELECT tenant_key, usage_date, request_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_calls, estimated_cost, trace_id, updated_at FROM tb_tenant_usage_daily WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND usage_date >= #{fromDate} AND usage_date <= #{toDate} ORDER BY usage_date ASC

SELECT tenant_key, usage_date, request_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_calls, estimated_cost, trace_id, updated_at FROM tb_tenant_usage_daily WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND usage_date >= #{monthFrom} AND usage_date <= #{monthTo} ORDER BY usage_date ASC
SELECT tenant_key, usage_date, request_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_calls, estimated_cost, trace_id, updated_at FROM tb_tenant_usage_daily ORDER BY tenant_key ASC, usage_date ASC
